visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy brown hair and a cream-colored slip dress stands in a minimalist living room with a white sofa. (2) The scene shifts to a table top where she displays a custom white gift box with 'Gina' printed on the inside lid. She unfolds a white satin sash with elegant black cursive text. Her hands are manicured with light-colored polish as she manipulates the smooth fabric. (3) She holds a white box containing a makeup brush set with white handles. The background is slightly blurred, focusing on her excited expression. She then presents a clear container of colorful, metallic-sheen spiral hair ties decorated with a white ribbon. (4) The woman shows a small, blue velvet jewelry case with gold initials 'OW' on the lid. She opens a beige circular case to reveal a delicate gold necklace with a 'Y' pendant resting on a velvet cushion. The lighting creates a soft sparkle on the gold. (5) She presents a white phone case with black text, followed by a large, pearlescent shark hair clip featuring the name 'Yuan' in crystals. She puts on heart-shaped white sunglasses with 'TEAM BRIDE' printed on the lenses, posing playfully. (6) She displays an Hermes-branded orange box and a glass bottle of skincare product with a pink-to-green gradient. The setting remains the same indoor environment. (7) She shows a set of grey satin pajamas with white piping and a custom letter 'C' embroidered on the pocket. She then fans out several brown sheet mask packets. (8) She holds a glass jar filled with plum wine, featuring a custom white label with black text. The video concludes with a wide shot of a long table elegantly decorated with numerous gift boxes, white floral arrangements, and candles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice begins narrating in Mandarin Chinese. An upbeat, synthesized pop BGM with a consistent electronic beat starts immediately. A sharp digital 'pop' sound effect accompanies the first visual cut. (2) The narration speed is fast as she describes the gift items. A 'whoosh' transition sound plays between clips. Every time a price tag appears visually, a bright 'ding' or chime SFX is audible, layered over the music. (3) The female speaker's tone remains cheerful and energetic. The BGM maintains a steady 115 BPM tempo. Faint sounds of rustling packaging are briefly audible behind the voice but are largely suppressed by the mix. (4) A 'twinkle' or magic sound effect plays when she showcases the necklace and jewelry case. The acoustic environment sounds like a clean, post-produced studio recording with high clarity. (5) As the video reaches the final summary of the cost, a rhythmic 'build-up' stinger SFX plays. The BGM and voice continue together with full intensity until the very end, concluding with a quick fade.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a shopping haul and gift-giving inspiration vlog, specifically focusing on bridesmaid proposal boxes. The creator details the contents and individual costs of the high-end gifts she curated, appealing to audiences interested in wedding planning and luxury lifestyle content.
